doc.brief: `GtkFileChooserNative` is an abstraction of a dialog suitable for use with “File Open” or “File Save as” commands.

get_accept_label.brief: Retrieves the custom label text for the accept button.
get_accept_label.md: Retrieves the custom label text for the accept button.

get_cancel_label.brief: Retrieves the custom label text for the cancel button.
get_cancel_label.md: Retrieves the custom label text for the cancel button.

set_accept_label.brief: Sets the custom label text for the accept button.
set_accept_label.md:
Sets the custom label text for the accept button.

If characters in `label` are preceded by an underscore, they are
underlined. If you need a literal underscore character in a label,
use “__” (two underscores). The first underlined character represents
a keyboard accelerator called a mnemonic.

Pressing Alt and that key should activate the button.
